ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  360 ONE WAM Limited reported robust business expansion in Q2 FY27, with Assets Under Management (AUM) growing 31.0% YoY and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) up 27.5% YoY. However, Profit After Tax (PAT) declined 4.4% YoY and 8.4% QoQ to Rs 302 crore, a material impact primarily driven by a significant negative "Other Income" of Rs (44) crore and a decline in transactional income. While operational revenue streams are strong, overall profitability was compressed, leading to a drop in Return on Tangible Equity.
